For each competency:
avg(STRENGTH_TO_SCORE for valid evidence)
strong=85 moderate=70
weak=50 contradictory=30

span.p:
level_for_score — rubric.py
≥80 = mastery
≥65 = proficient
≥45 = developing
<45 = novice

span.p:
assign_verdict — verdict.py
score≥70 + ev≥2 + words≥30 → solid
score≥45 + ev≥1 → shaky
else → couldnt_defend
